description: Source code for the 'Catalog' class in Apache Spark SQL Connect module, providing catalog management functionalities such as listing, retrieving, creating, caching, and invalidating tables, databases, functions, and catalogs.

classes.name: Catalog
classes.description: Provides catalog management operations such as listing, retrieving, creating, caching, and invalidating tables, databases, functions, and catalogs within a Spark session.

methods.name: currentDatabase
methods.description: Returns the current default database in this session.

methods.name: setCurrentDatabase
methods.description: Sets the current database (namespace) in this session.

methods.name: listDatabases
methods.description: Returns a list of databases (namespaces) available within the current catalog.

methods.name: listDatabases(pattern: String)
methods.description: Returns a list of databases matching the pattern.

methods.name: listTables
methods.description: Returns a list of tables/views in the current database.

methods.name: listTables(dbName: String)
methods.description: Returns a list of tables/views in the specified database.

methods.name: listTables(dbName: String, pattern: String)
methods.description: Returns a list of tables/views matching pattern in the specified database.

methods.name: listFunctions
methods.description: Returns a list of functions in the current database.

methods.name: listFunctions(dbName: String)
methods.description: Returns a list of functions in the specified database.

methods.name: listFunctions(dbName: String, pattern: String)
methods.description: Returns a list of functions matching pattern in the specified database.

methods.name: listColumns(tableName: String)
methods.description: Returns a list of columns for the given table/view or temporary view.

methods.name: listColumns(dbName: String, tableName: String)
methods.description: Returns a list of columns for the specified table/view in a database.

methods.name: getDatabase
methods.description: Retrieves the database with the specified name.

methods.name: getTable(tableName: String)
methods.description: Retrieves the table or view with the specified name.

methods.name: getTable(dbName: String, tableName: String)
methods.description: Retrieves the table/view with the specified name in a database.

methods.name: getFunction(functionName: String)
methods.description: Retrieves the function with the specified name.

methods.name: getFunction(dbName: String, functionName: String)
methods.description: Retrieves the function with the specified name in a database.

methods.name: databaseExists
methods.description: Checks if a database exists.

methods.name: tableExists
methods.description: Checks if a table/view exists.

methods.name: tableExists(dbName: String, tableName: String)
methods.description: Checks if a table/view exists in a specific database.

methods.name: functionExists
methods.description: Checks if a function exists.

methods.name: functionExists(dbName: String, functionName: String)
methods.description: Checks if a function exists in a specific database.

methods.name: createTable(tableName: String, path: String)
methods.description: Creates a table from a path.

methods.name: createTable(tableName: String, path: String, source: String)
methods.description: Creates a table from a path with specified data source.

methods.name: createTable(tableName: String, source: String, options: Map[String, String])
methods.description: Creates a table based on a data source and options.

methods.name: createTable(tableName: String, source: String, description: String, options: Map[String, String])
methods.description: Creates a table with specified source, description, and options.

methods.name: dropTempView
methods.description: Drops a local temporary view.

methods.name: dropGlobalTempView
methods.description: Drops a global temporary view.

methods.name: recoverPartitions
methods.description: Recovers all partitions in a table's directory.

methods.name: isCached
methods.description: Checks if a table is cached.

methods.name: cacheTable
methods.description: Caches a table in-memory.

methods.name: cacheTable(tableName: String, storageLevel: StorageLevel)
methods.description: Caches a table with a specific storage level.

methods.name: uncacheTable
methods.description: Removes a table from cache.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears all cached tables.

methods.name: refreshTable
methods.description: Refreshes cache and metadata for a table.

methods.name: refreshByPath
methods.description: Refreshes cache for data source path.

methods.name: currentCatalog
methods.description: Returns the current catalog.

methods.name: setCurrentCatalog
methods.description: Sets the current catalog.

methods.name: listCatalogs
methods.description: Lists available catalogs.

methods.name: listCatalogs(pattern: String)
methods.description: Lists catalogs matching pattern.
